title: Frontend Developer
description:
We are seeking a skilled Frontend Developer to join the digital products team at Home Credit Bank Kazakhstan. You will work on customer-facing web applications used by hundreds of thousands of clients daily.

Responsibilities:
— Develop new features for our customer-facing web banking application
— Build reusable, accessible UI components using React and TypeScript
— Integrate with REST APIs and GraphQL endpoints
— Implement state management with Redux Toolkit / RTK Query
— Write unit and integration tests (Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress)
— Collaborate with designers (Figma) and backend engineers
— Optimize application performance and bundle size
— Participate in code reviews and architectural decisions

Requirements:
— 3+ years of commercial frontend development experience
— Strong proficiency in React (hooks, context, performance optimization)
— Solid TypeScript skills
— Experience with Redux or other state management solutions
— Good understanding of modern CSS (Flexbox, Grid, CSS-in-JS)
— Familiarity with build tools (Vite, Webpack)
— Understanding of web accessibility (WCAG)

Nice to have: Next.js, experience in fintech, knowledge of micro-frontends architecture, Storybook.
